title: Kinora 1.0.0
items: Unified motion workspace across generation, library search, editing, splicing, scene playback, and robot retargeting.
Built-in Unitree G1 (23 DoF) retargeting with optional prebuilt accelerated runtime and automatic fallback.
Custom robot URDF/MJCF import, 3D mesh-based editing, and Gadget CLI/MCP integration.
Desktop installers for macOS (Universal) and Ubuntu 22.04+ (x86_64).
